rows.behavior: kmctl's README Upgrade section and the APM how-to tell a v0.12 user, in order, to install the new CLI first, change the apm.yml entry to path packages/kmctl/apm with the new ref (written out in full), run apm install and kmctl plugin patch, and check with kmctl doctor last; they name just upgrade for starter projects; kmctl's README links kmaudit's README for auditing.
rows.fails_when: either page lacks the CLI-first step, puts doctor before apm install, omits the full new entry or just upgrade, or kmctl's README does not link kmaudit's README
